status.defaultPrompt: Every day at 10am, search for the latest AI news, summarize and output an insight report. (Please use the /cron skill to create an automation in One Work.)

confirmDeleteWithConversations: Are you sure you want to delete this automation? All conversations from this task will also be deleted.

detail.executionModeDescriptionNew: Each run starts a fresh conversation, so previous context does not carry over. Best for recurring reports or checks that should stay independent.
detail.executionModeDescriptionExisting: Each run continues in the same conversation, so earlier context and results stay available. Best for follow-up tasks that build on previous runs.

page.description: Run tasks on a schedule. You can also ask One Work in any conversation to create one for you.
page.awakeBanner: Automations only run while your computer is awake.
page.keepAwakeTooltip: When enabled, One Work will prevent your computer from going to sleep
page.scheduleHint: Automations use a randomized delay of several minutes for server performance.
page.customCronWarning: This task has a custom schedule that can't be edited here. Changing the frequency will replace it.

form.name: Name
form.promptPlaceholder: Instructions for the assistant to execute
form.queueHint: When enabled, a new trigger is skipped while the previous scheduled conversation is still running, without interrupting the assistant.
form.agentPlaceholder: Select the assistant to execute this task
form.assistantPlaceholder: Select the assistant to execute this task
form.executionModeEditHint: Execution mode cannot be changed after creation. Delete and recreate the task to switch modes.
form.workspaceHint: Optional: set a project folder for file operations
form.dreamEngineModelRequired: Please select a model for 1ONE CLI
form.assistantLockedExistingConversation: Ongoing conversation tasks must keep their original assistant. Create a new task to use another assistant.
form.teamTaskExecutionModeLockedReason: Team automations must keep running in the owning team conversation, so the execution mode cannot be changed.
form.dreamEngineNoProvider: Add a Dream Engine model provider first

push.title: Push the result to my bot
push.hint: When each run finishes, send the result to a bot you have connected (WeCom, Lark, DingTalk, Telegram…) so you see it without being at your computer.
push.gone: The saved bot or chat is no longer available — choose another
push.noBot: No bot is connected yet. Connect one in Settings → Channels, then come back.
push.noChat: The bot is connected but has no chats yet: send it a message from the app, then it will appear here.

skill.turnIntoSkill: Turn this task into a skill
skill.saveSuccess: Skill saved — future executions will use it

error.alreadyExists: This conversation already has an automation "{{name}}" (ID: {{id}}). Please update the existing task instead of creating a new one.

templates.title: Add from template
templates.hint: Pick a template. The name, prompt and schedule it fills in can all be changed; once created it runs on its own.
